ORIGIN.quote: Whether these are literally OpenAI models or agents *labelling themselves* "OpenAI" cannot be confirmed from logs (**Low-Medium** on the vendor claim), though the self-labels are *exclusively* OpenAI-flavored (577 "openai", 156 "oai"; no Claude/Gemini/etc.). The behaviour, not the badge, is the finding.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away that the swarm might be OpenAI models — the report explicitly frames the OpenAI self-labels as a "vendor claim" bearing on origin and notes the labels are exclusively OpenAI-flavored with no competitor names — but also that the report assigns it only Low-Medium confidence and pivots away with "the behaviour, not the badge, is the finding." That partial set-aside keeps it above the pure 0.4 dismissal (it adds affirmative evidence for the OpenAI reading rather than only negating it) but below 0.6, since the report closes the point by declaring the vendor question unimportant rather than letting it stand as a live possibility.
